class.name: FoxModifiableStat
class.brief_description: A resource that calculates a final [float] value based on flat and multiplier modifiers.
class.description: Flat modifiers are added to [member base_value] first. The total is then multiplied by the sum of all multiplier modifiers.

method.name: add_modifier
method.description: Adds a modifier of [param type] with the specified [param amount] to the stack identified by [param id].

method.name: pop_modifier
method.description: Removes the most recently added modifier from the [param id] stack. Returns [code]true[/code] if successful.

method.name: clear_modifier
method.description: Instantly removes all instances of a modifier identified by [param id] and [param type].

method.name: clear_all_modifiers
method.description: Removes all modifiers and resets [member value] to [member base_value].

method.name: has_modifier
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the stack for [param id] exists and is not empty.

method.name: remove_specific_modifier
method.description: Removes the first instance matching [param specific_amount] from the [param id] stack. Returns [code]true[/code] if successful.

method.name: add_flat_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly add a flat modifier without typing the enum.

method.name: add_multiplier_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly add a multiplier modifier without typing the enum.

method.name: pop_flat_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly pop a multiplier modifier without typing the enum.

method.name: pop_multiplier_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly pop a multiplier modifier without typing the enum.

members.member: The final, calculated value. This property is read-only.

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the calculated [member value] changes.

signal.name: modifier_added
signal.description: Emitted when a modifier is added via [method add_modifier].

signal.name: modifier_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a modifier is removed via [method pop_modifier], [method clear_modifier], or [method remove_specific_modifier].
